findings.text: the committed landing fragment records the population as "base 247 passed and 1 pre-existing failure ... head 251 passed and the same 1", but the manifest's own baseline_suite and after_suite and the only retained population logs (population-base-n8.log, population-head-n8.log) both read 0 failures (248 and 252 passed), so the fragment's numbers belong to an unretained first run and no reader can reconcile the fragment with the cited gate logs.

_adopt_live_fleet_allocation catches only fleet_node.FleetNodeError around query_jobs, which calls subprocess.run without wrapping OSError, so a missing or unrunnable squeue client raises FileNotFoundError out of ensure_reservation on the no-record path, where the adjacent mint call at placement.py:558 wraps (OSError, SubprocessError) into a CrewError, leaving the two branches of one decision inconsistent.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 4d852e70: placement.py adds the adoption branch and _adopted_result, fleet_node.py adds query_jobs' runner seam plus allocation_shape and parse_memory_gb, dispatch.py adds _carry_declared_placement and the resume-path placement resolution, and the node adds one test file and one evidence fragment; no unrelated edits.
item_verdicts.done_when: the declared measure is a focused four-case file, a base/head population over the importers of placement/fleet_node/resumption with no added failing id, and a negative control; focused-head.log reads "4 passed", population-base-n8.log "248 passed" and population-head-n8.log "252 passed" with 0 failures at both arms, and negative-control-adoption-branch-removed.log reddens the first case on the named allocation-obtaining request ("assert 1 == 0" from _allocation_requests()).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is for ensure_reservation to adopt a live supervisor-running fleet allocation the fleet record names into the one unkeyed record while submitting nothing, with the resume path placing the resumed worker as an --overlap step in that job; reckon/crew/placement.py:463-519 _adopt_live_fleet_allocation plus the else branch at :547 do exactly that and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:8252 resolves placement on the resume path, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names both commits, the mechanism, the four figures, the negative control and a follow-on for two load-sensitive ids; its commits list resolves (43ba4465, 7e9a4e94) and its evidence_inputs correctly reports that the fence's placement.py comment was already landed at base ("carried nowhere else" at 4d852e70:487), so no correction was owed there.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven write paths; git diff 4d852e70..7e9a4e94 touches five — reckon/crew/placement.py, reckon/crew/fleet_node.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_the_fleet_allocation_is_adopted.py and the evidence fragment — every one inside the grant; reckon/crew/resumption.py and the figures directory are declared but the change needed neither, which is not a violation.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_fleet_allocation_is_adopted.py isolates RECKON_HOME and FLEET_STATE_DIR and puts a recording scheduler on PATH, so no allocation is submitted, adopted or cancelled for real, and adoption sits under the cross-process lock; minus two for the unguarded OSError path at placement.py:491.
justifications.evidence: focused-head.log 4 passed and population baseline/head logs 248 vs 252 passed with 0 failures at both arms over the exact 18 importers I re-derived, and a real negative control; but the committed evidence fragment cites a first population run (247+1 / 251+1) that no retained log carries, so its figures are unverifiable from disk.
justifications.fit: _adopt_live_fleet_allocation reuses fleet_node.find_allocation/find_allocations and adds no second hold path, the runner seam follows query_jobs' existing subprocess idiom, and every new name (_adopted_result, allocation_shape, parse_memory_gb, _carry_declared_placement) is mechanism-named with no plan or version token.
justifications.goal_fidelity: placement.py:463 _adopt_live_fleet_allocation reads the recorded job's shape from the scheduler (squeue %P|%C|%m) and the else branch at :547 publishes it and returns adopted with started=False, and dispatch.py:8252 makes a resumed placed backend an overlapping step in that job — the goal in full, with the release of 1276262 belonging to the coordinator, not this node.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 4d852e70..7e9a4e94 is five files, 524 insertions and 4 deletions, every path inside the manifest's declared write grants, with resumption.py and the figures directory declared but untouched.
